variants.minimal: white bg, underline accent, single CTA
variants.gradient-overlay: full gradient bg with decorative circles, white text
variants.light-split: white bg, text left + framed image card right, accent rule
variants.light-editorial: light gray bg, centered editorial headline with a thin divider rule
variants.light-showcase: white bg, centered text above a full-width image band

lines: NOTE: "left", "centered", "split", "video-style" and "gradient-overlay" all render on a dark full-bleed background. The three "light-*" ones and "minimal" render on a light background — pick a light one when the brand should feel airy, clean or editorial rather than bold.
